30/G.goal: Explain how human auditory perception and binaural sound localization are used to design and render immersive sound in XR.
30/G.achieves: It gives the learner foundational human-factors knowledge for evaluating and implementing the auditory component of an XR system, supporting the course's aim of building immersive XR systems with confidence.

30/O1.goal: Describe the perceptual and psychoacoustic principles behind XR sound design.
30/O1.achieves: It gives the learner a basis for evaluating how XR sound effects are selected and adjusted according to human auditory perception, supporting the course's human factors focus.

30/O2.goal: Explain the principles and rendering techniques behind localized binaural sound in XR.
30/O2.achieves: It helps the learner understand how spatial audio supports presence when evaluating or developing an XR system.
